commit_message: Preserve managed integrity gate in resource workers
pr_title: Fix managed Local AI inference and benchmark campaigns
pr_body: Fixes the four confirmed managed Local AI gaps: move full managed integrity verification off the Editor UI thread, replace fixed 999 GPU layers with llama.cpp memory fitting, surface inference failures in Conversation, and connect benchmark campaigns to the GameEngine-managed Windows Native / WSL2 GGUF runtime while retaining compatible-backend support. This repair also preserves the ADR 0155 integrity gate for model residency operations by running it on the existing model-resource worker instead of the Editor frame thread.
